title: Welcome to Sauri
intro: Two steps are left: Sauri installs the AI models that process your meetings on this Mac, and then you connect the Chrome extension that records them.

models.title: Models for this Mac
models.intro: Sauri picks and installs the models that work best on this Mac on its own. They download once, and from then on everything is processed here, without sending anything out.
models.later: If you want a different model later, you can change it in Settings › Engines and models.
models.lowMemory: This Mac has less than 16 GB of memory. Sauri works, but processing a meeting takes longer and the Mac may slow down while it works, especially with many apps open. We recommend 16 GB or more; you can also send summaries to an external service from Settings › Engines and models.
models.waiting: Finishing a check of what is already installed…
models.estimate: About {{size}} in total. It may take a few minutes depending on your connection.
models.ready: All set: Sauri can now transcribe, tell who is speaking and summarize on this Mac.
models.noLocal: {{process}}: this Mac can't do it here. You can use an external service from Settings.

failed.offline: We couldn't download the models. Check your internet connection and try again; what already finished installing is kept.
failed.disk: There isn't enough disk space: {{needed}} are needed and {{free}} are free. Free up some space and try again.
failed.unavailable: Part of Sauri isn't available to download yet. You can continue and finish later from Settings.
failed.host: Sauri isn't responding right now. Wait a few seconds and try again.
failed.generic: We couldn't finish the installation. Try again.

models.skipHelp: You can finish the installation later from Settings › Engines and models.

extension.title: Connect the Chrome extension
extension.intro: The extension records your Google Meet meetings and sends them to Sauri on this Mac.
extension.install: Install from the Chrome Web Store
extension.how: After installing it, open it once in Chrome: it connects to this Mac on its own.
extension.waiting: Waiting for the extension. This notice changes on its own once it connects.
extension.statusError: I couldn't check whether the extension is connected.
extension.later: You can connect it later; Sauri already works with recordings you upload yourself.

finishError: I couldn't save that you finished setup. Try again.
